shouldFix.title: The successor reasserts v3's superseded pre-D-102 condition-4 state
shouldFix.finding: V4 says it is a scoped D-086 successor and pins the current file-08 digest, but most of the document remains a present-tense copy of v3's pre-D-088/pre-D-102 snapshot. It calls G03/G04 naming-blocked, unpinned, unnamed, and zero-progress; says a future MF-6 would move condition 4 from 0 of 18 toward 16 of 18; and says condition 4 would remain not MET. At the pinned file-08 bytes, adopted D-102 has already named G03/G04 under the hosted-fleet-class contract and condition 4 is 18 of 18, MET.
evidence: Live file 08 at the subject's own pin 7128f62ecea3d8121b670359fa0ca0bce4ec2df8a8f4680bb3edba09f42b865f says G03 and G04 are named by D-102 and the condition-4 snapshot is 18 of 18 required identifiers, MET.

Adopted D-102 at b838e72d3758a53cbefdb077fb6836d12ee7214f supersedes D-006's exact-machine/exact-OS requirement for G03/G04 only, adopts the hosted-fleet-class contract, writes the two identifiers, and makes condition 4 MET without claiming QUALIFIED.

V4 sliceScope.reservedBlockedOnD006MachinePins, the G03/G04 gate records, runnerClassFromD006, remainingUnmetNamed, condition4EffectIfLaterRecorded, and commissionNote all retain the earlier unpinned / unnamed / 16-of-18 state.

condition4EffectIfLaterRecorded specifically projects a later move from 0 of 18 toward 16 of 18 and says G03/G04 remain unnamed; commissionNote says the successor does not change the 16/18 arithmetic. Both are false at the cited current register bytes.

basedOn.relation limits the intended normative delta to G20/G21 executes and doesNotClaim, but the artifact does not label the conflicting inherited fields as historical/non-operative and does not say D-088 and D-102 remain controlling. Recording the whole successor would therefore leave two incompatible current-state narratives.
shouldFix.impact: A later D-000 recording could be read as reopening D-102's settled fleet-class/name result or regressing condition 4 from MET to a stale 16-of-18 projection. The explicit G20/G21-only relation and binds-NOTHING status constrain the immediate damage, so this is SHOULD-FIX rather than a blocker, but an identity-bearing successor cannot safely carry the contradiction into adoption.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Make the scoped-overlay boundary explicit and current. Either rebase the current-standing fields on D-102 (G03/G04 named under the hosted-fleet-class contract; condition 4 18/18 MET; no future 0-to-16 MF-6) or move the unmodified v3 material under a clearly historical, non-operative basis and state that v4 normatively changes only G20/G21 executes/doesNotClaim and does not overturn D-088 or D-102. Remove or historical-label the obsolete unpinned, unnamed, 16/18, and future-MF-6 assertions, then freeze a successor for fresh review. Preserve all no-QUALIFIED and no-implementation boundaries.

advisories.title: The version-chain predecessor still points from v4 to v2
advisories.finding: V4 correctly adds basedOn.path gate-harness-naming.v3.json at b5236612, but its predecessor and predecessorSha256 fields still name v2 at dcc40159. predecessorVerdictFindings likewise stops at v2 even though v3 had Codex advisory GHN-V3-A1 and D-086 adopted v3 with operative rider RB-GHN-V3-A1.
advisories.whyNotShouldFix: basedOn unambiguously pins v3 and D-086, and recordedInputs repeats that exact v3 identity. The wrong predecessor label does not change the NT mapping or authority boundary; it is lineage clarity. GHN-V4-SF1 already requires removal or historical labeling of the stale v3 state, including the obsolete MF-6 wording implicated by RB-GHN-V3-A1.
advisories.suggestion: Make v3 the immediate predecessor, or rename the retained v2 fields as historical review ancestry and add a v3 disposition that names GHN-V3-A1 and D-086 rider RB-GHN-V3-A1.
